# LibertyIQ

> Free conservative arguments library and quiz platform at https://libertyiq.org

LibertyIQ helps users study structured conservative debate topics with biblical foundations, scientific evidence, defense tips, knowledge quizzes, and a public speaking trainer.

## About

- **Site:** https://libertyiq.org
- **Purpose:** Educational resource for conservative arguments and debate preparation
- **Cost:** Free — no account required
- **Progress storage:** Browser localStorage only

## Key Pages

- [Home — Argument Library](https://libertyiq.org/)
- [Quiz Dashboard](https://libertyiq.org/libertyiq)
- [Speaking Trainer](https://libertyiq.org/speaking-trainer)

## Topics (11)

Each topic includes structured arguments, evidence, defense tips, a full topic page, and a quiz with three difficulty levels.

1. [Pro-Life Position](https://libertyiq.org/topic/pro-life) — [Quiz](https://libertyiq.org/quiz/pro-life)
2. [Illegal Immigration](https://libertyiq.org/topic/immigration) — [Quiz](https://libertyiq.org/quiz/illegal-immigration)

6. [Pro-Israel](https://libertyiq.org/topic/pro-israel) — [Quiz](https://libertyiq.org/quiz/pro-israel)
7. [National Security](https://libertyiq.org/topic/national-security) — [Quiz](https://libertyiq.org/quiz/national-security)
8. [Anti-Climate Alarmism](https://libertyiq.org/topic/anti-climate-alarmism) — [Quiz](https://libertyiq.org/quiz/anti-climate-alarmism)

## Quiz Rank System

- **Intern Analyst** — Pass Easy quiz (70%+)
- **Senior Fellow** — Pass Medium quiz (75%+)
- **Chief Strategist** — Pass Hard quiz (80%+)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is LibertyIQ?**
LibertyIQ is a free online conservative arguments library and quiz platform at LibertyIQ.org.

**What topics does LibertyIQ cover?**
Eleven debate topics: Pro-Life, Illegal Immigration, Second Amendment, Marriage, Two Sexes, Pro-Israel, National Security, Anti-Climate Alarmism, Limited Government, Anti-CRT, and Crime & Justice.

**Is LibertyIQ free?**
Yes. No account, subscription, or payment is required.

**What is the speaking trainer?**
A browser-based tool at /speaking-trainer that transcribes speech, counts filler words, and provides coaching tips.
